findings.description: insert_ai_revision raises RuntimeError("could not allocate a revision_no for video {video_id}") when all 3 retry attempts fail due to concurrent unique violations (SQLSTATE 23505) on the (video_id, revision_no) key. This is a new failure mode not exposed by the old insert_incident RPC, which handled conflicts atomically server-side. During intended usage with 3+ simultaneous analyses of the same video, the 3rd attempt can still fail, causing the entire analysis to abort.

revision_facets silently returns None for boolean severity_level values, leaving the severity_level column NULL in report_revisions. The function correctly guards with isinstance(severity, int) and not isinstance(severity, bool), but callers sending Python bool True/False as severity_level will have the facet silently dropped rather than raised as an error, which is a silent data-quality concern rather than a crash.

testing_summary: No tests executed during review per pipeline directive; all test-file changes were reviewed through diff inspection.
risk_rationale: The changes successfully move the VSS agent and its mock backend onto the new versioned report database (report_revisions with JSONB payload/evidence) as the user intent requires. The captain's hand-applied schema and 'no migration script' directive are respected throughout. The two findings are contained mechanical issues (retry limit, edge-case facet handling) that do not subvert the authorized change.
